journey.name: LC-04 A half-typed form survives process death
journey.description:
Covers NFR-07, the strongest state guarantee in the brief and the one no unit test can prove on a device. The editor writes every field into SavedStateHandle under the keys form_title, form_notes, form_priority and form_due_date, and a restored form is never reloaded over.
`am kill` is a no-op against a foreground process, so the app must be backgrounded first. This is the closest an unrooted device gets to the real thing; the "Don't keep activities" developer option is the alternative recipe and is listed in qa/README.md.
The list's own query and sort are deliberately NOT expected to survive - see LC-05.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Type "Survives the reaper" into the "Title" field
Type "Typed but never saved" into the "Notes (optional)" field
Using adb, kill the app process with `am kill com.rounds.test.to_dolist`
Reopen the app from the recents list
Verify that the title "New task" is on screen
Verify that the "Title" field still contains "Survives the reaper"
Verify that the "Notes (optional)" field still contains "Typed but never saved"
Verify that the "High" priority chip is still selected
